body.statement: Under the balanced rank-one one-chart assumptions, for all sufficiently large even \(n\), the total algorithm \(\mathsf{WSVD}_n\) is randomized polynomial-time and \[(\widehat L_n,\widehat R_{\alpha,n})\in\mathcal H_{\alpha,n},\qquad \sup_{\vartheta_n\in\Theta_n}\mathbb E_{\mathbb Q_{\vartheta,n},\Xi_n,\Zeta_n}[\widehat R_{\alpha,n}]\le C\sigma\sqrt n,\] where \(C\) depends only on \(\alpha,\mu,\kappa,s_-,s_+\). Honesty includes every singular or failed-stability sample through the deterministic fallback, and the expected-radius assertion follows by adding the separately controlled conditional Gaussian, simulation, homogeneous Taylor, and fallback terms in Lemma \ref{lem:balanced-radius-audit}.
body.justification: This benchmark-only lemma supplies the constructive half of the field-grade minimax frontier.
body.gap: Existing results do not give a total polynomial-time honest nuclear ball with every expected-radius component verified at the balanced L-mask scale.
body.consumer: The principal frontier theorem uses this certificate for its upper bound.
